name: Verify assistant asks clarifying questions on low confidence input
objective: Validate that when the user provides a vague or ambiguous description, the assistant asks clarifying questions to better understand the issue.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open after clicking the Agentforce icon.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page

steps.expectedResult: Message is submitted to the assistant

steps.description: Verify the assistant asks clarifying questions
steps.expectedResult: The assistant responds with one or more clarifying questions to understand what is broken

steps.description: Respond to the clarifying question with more detail
steps.testData: "My email application crashes when I open it"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant maintains conversation context and now identifies the issue as an email/application problem
